cards.title: Seven Black Ships
cards.text: While this **Subject** is in the **Rear**, it gets +1 **Strength**.

cards.title: Those Who Came Back
cards.text: While your **discard pile** contains at least 5 cards, this **Subject** gets +1 **Strength**.

cards.title: The House at Orra
cards.text: While an **adjacent** **Subject** you control has both a **Link** and a **Name**, this **Subject** gets +1 **Strength**.

cards.title: The Children of the Salt Road
cards.text: When you play a **Link** on this **Subject**, it gets +1 **Strength** for this **Battle**.

cards.title: The Three Brothers of Avar
cards.text: *Frontline only.*

cards.title: Followed
cards.text: Its **Subject** gets +1 **Strength**. While this **Link** has a **Name**, its **Subject** gets +2 additional **Strength**.

cards.title: Swore To
cards.text: Its **Subject** gets +1 **Strength**. While this **Link** has a **Name**, its **Subject** gets +3 additional **Strength**.

cards.title: Defied
cards.text: Its **Subject** gets +1 **Strength**. While this **Link** has a **Name**, its **Subject** gets +1 additional **Strength** and the opponent has -2 **Strength** in this **Front**.

cards.title: Carried
cards.text: Its **Subject** gets +1 **Strength**. While this **Link** has a **Name**, its **Subject** gets +1 additional **Strength** and that **Subject** cannot be chosen by an opponent's **Plot**.

cards.title: Avenged
cards.text: Its **Subject** gets +1 **Strength**. While this **Link** has a **Name**, its **Subject** gets +1 additional **Strength** for each of your cards **discarded** this **Battle**, up to +3.

cards.title: Namar
cards.text: While *Namar* is attached to a **Subject** in the **Frontline**, that **Subject** gets +2 **Strength**.

cards.title: Iria
cards.text: When you play *Iria*, you may **move** this **Subject** and all cards attached to it to an **adjacent** empty position.

cards.title: Teyra
cards.text: When you play *Teyra*, reveal the enemy **Scheme** in this **Front**, if there is one.

cards.title: The Story Is False
cards.text: Choose an opponent's **Subject**. If it has a **Link**, **discard** that **Link**. Otherwise, that **Subject** gets -2 **Strength** for this **Battle**.

cards.title: He Never Came
cards.text: Choose an opponent's **Subject**. If it has a **Name**, **return** that **Name** to its owner's hand. Otherwise, that **Subject** gets -2 **Strength** for this **Battle**.

cards.title: They Chose Another
cards.text: **Move** one of your **Subjects**, together with all cards attached to it, to any legal empty position on your side.

cards.title: The Lamps Went Dark
cards.text: **Scheme** — While this is face-down, you have +1 **Strength** in this **Front**. When your opponent plays a **Subject** here, reveal this. That **Subject** gets -3 **Strength** for this **Battle**.

cards.title: The Road Was Cut
cards.text: **Scheme** — While this is face-down, you have +1 **Strength** in this **Front**. When your opponent plays a **Link** here, reveal this. **Discard** that **Link**.

cards.title: The Hidden Oars
cards.text: **Scheme** — While this is face-down, you have +1 **Strength** in this **Front**. When your opponent **Passes**, if you control a **Subject** here, reveal this. Your **Frontline Subject** here gets +3 **Strength** for this **Battle**; if you have none, your **Rear Subject** here gets +3 instead.

cards.title: The Witness Lied
cards.text: **Scheme** — While this is face-down, you have +1 **Strength** in this **Front**. After an opponent's **Plot** targets a card you control here, reveal this. Your **Frontline Subject** here gets +3 **Strength** for this **Battle**; if you have none, your **Rear Subject** here gets +3 instead.
